description:
The most intuitive desktop API client. Organize and execute REST, GraphQL, WebSockets, Server Sent Events, and gRPC. ![Yaak 2026.9.1](https://yaak.app/changelog-og/2026.9.1/banner.png?v=3) The [changelog for 2026.9.1](https://yaak.app/changelog/2026.9.1) has the full write-up, with screenshots of the headline features. Here's everything that changed. ### 🛠️ Fixed • Update the bundled Node.js runtime and the HTTP engine to patch the Brotli decoder vulnerability (CVE-2026-111497) ([feedback](https://yaak.app/feedback/posts/yaaknode-exe-contains-critical-vulnerability-cve-2026-111497))
> *These binaries follow Yaak's [pricing terms](https://yaak.app/pricing)：free for personal use, license required for commercial use. The source is MIT licensed and can be built and run for free, for both personal and commercial use.*
